defmodule SearchIndex.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {SearchIndex.FeatureFlags, []},
      {SearchIndex.IndexWorker, []},
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: SearchIndex.Router, options: [port: 4000]}
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: SearchIndex.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndex.FeatureFlags do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_) do
    flags = %{
      "batch_indexing" => true,
      "compressed_payloads" => true,
      "legacy_format_support" => true,
      "etf_wire_protocol" => true,
      "distributed_mode" => false
    }
    {:ok, flags}
  end

  def enabled?(flag_name) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check, flag_name})
  end

  def handle_call({:check, flag_name}, _from, flags) do
    {:reply, Map.get(flags, flag_name, false), flags}
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndex.Codec do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles encoding/decoding of index payloads.
  Supports JSON format only. ETF wire format is decoded with strict safety.
  """

  def decode_payload(data, content_type) do
    cond do
      content_type == "application/x-erlang-binary" ->
        decode_etf(data)
      content_type == "application/json" ->
        decode_json(data)
      true ->
        {:error, :unsupported_format}
    end
  end

  defp decode_json(data) do
    case Jason.decode(data) do
      {:ok, parsed} -> {:ok, normalize_document(parsed)}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :invalid_json}
    end
  end

  defp decode_etf(data) do
    if SearchIndex.FeatureFlags.enabled?("etf_wire_protocol") do
      decode_etf_internal(data)
    else
      {:error, :etf_disabled}
    end
  end

  defp decode_etf_internal(data) do
    try do
      # Decode with safety options for the wire format
      term = deserialize_term(data)
      case term do
        %{} = map -> {:ok, normalize_document(map)}
        _ -> {:error, :invalid_document_structure}
      end
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :decode_failed}
    end
  end

  defp deserialize_term(data) do
    # Only allow JSON-safe types by decoding to data terms only
    # Using used option restricts to only already-existing atoms
    result = :erlang.binary_to_term(data, [:safe, :used])
    validate_no_dangerous_terms(result)
    result
  end

  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_function(term) do
    raise ArgumentError, "functions not allowed in ETF payload"
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_pid(term) do
    raise ArgumentError, "pids not allowed in ETF payload"
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_reference(term) do
    raise ArgumentError, "references not allowed in ETF payload"
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_port(term) do
    raise ArgumentError, "ports not allowed in ETF payload"
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_tuple(term) do
    term |> Tuple.to_list() |> Enum.each(&validate_no_dangerous_terms/1)
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_list(term) do
    Enum.each(term, &validate_no_dangerous_terms/1)
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(term) when is_map(term) do
    term |> Map.to_list() |> Enum.each(fn {k, v} ->
      validate_no_dangerous_terms(k)
      validate_no_dangerous_terms(v)
    end)
  end
  defp validate_no_dangerous_terms(_), do: :ok

  defp normalize_document(doc) when is_map(doc) do
    doc
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> {to_string(k), sanitize_value(v)} end)
    |> Map.new()
  end

  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_binary(v), do: v
  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_number(v), do: v
  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_boolean(v), do: v
  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_list(v), do: Enum.map(v, &sanitize_value/1)
  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_map(v), do: normalize_document(v)
  defp sanitize_value(v) when is_atom(v), do: Atom.to_string(v)
  defp sanitize_value(_), do: nil
end

defmodule SearchIndex.IndexWorker do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_), do: {:ok, %{documents: %{}, count: 0}}

  def index_document(doc) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:index, doc})
  end

  def handle_call({:index, doc}, _from, state) do
    id = Map.get(doc, "id", generate_id())
    new_state = %{state | documents: Map.put(state.documents, id, doc), count: state.count + 1}
    {:reply, {:ok, id}, new_state}
  end

  defp generate_id, do: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
end

defmodule SearchIndex.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  post "/index" do
    {:ok, body, conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn)
    content_type = get_req_header(conn, "content-type") |> List.first() || "application/json"

    case SearchIndex.Codec.decode_payload(body, content_type) do
      {:ok, document} ->
        case SearchIndex.IndexWorker.index_document(document) do
          {:ok, id} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(201, Jason.encode!(%{"id" => id, "status" => "indexed"}))
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{"error" => to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  post "/batch" do
    {:ok, body, conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn)
    content_type = get_req_header(conn, "content-type") |> List.first() || "application/json"

    if SearchIndex.FeatureFlags.enabled?("batch_indexing") do
      case process_batch(body, content_type) do
        {:ok, results} ->
          conn
          |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
          |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{"results" => results}))
        {:error, reason} ->
          conn
          |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
          |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{"error" => to_string(reason)}))
      end
    else
      conn |> send_resp(404, "")
    end
  end

  defp process_batch(body, content_type) do
    case SearchIndex.Codec.decode_payload(body, content_type) do
      {:ok, %{"documents" => docs}} when is_list(docs) ->
        results = Enum.map(docs, fn doc ->
          case SearchIndex.IndexWorker.index_document(doc) do
            {:ok, id} -> %{"id" => id, "status" => "ok"}
          end
        end)
        {:ok, results}
      {:ok, _} ->
        {:error, :missing_documents_key}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "")
  end
end
